reading.requirement: Exact source text hash and evidence offsets must match.

listening.requirement: Official matching Conversation MP3, audio hash, text/audio alignment and rights review must pass; spokenEvidence excludes silent directions.

modalityPolicy.independentExposure: Reading and audio of this same source share one exposure group; neither is a new unseen parallel test after the other.

questions.prompt: At the start, what does Anna want to do?
questions.evidence: Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?
questions.explanation: Anna明确说 I want to work out，然后询问健身房在哪里。work out在这里是“锻炼”，所以选To exercise。mailroom只是后面走错的地点，不能反推她最初要取信；原音也没有说她要见老师。

spokenEvidence.quote: Pete, I want to work out. Where is the gym?

questions.prompt: Which room is opposite the gym?
questions.evidence: The gym is across from the lounge.
questions.explanation: across from表示“在……对面”，因此健身房对面是lounge。mailroom在前面的描述中是next to，也就是紧挨着；garage是Anna走错的地方。不能把“对面”“旁边”和“误入地点”混为一谈。

spokenEvidence.quote: The gym is across from the lounge.

questions.prompt: Pete says the gym is behind which area? Write ONE WORD from the conversation.
questions.evidence: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.
questions.explanation: 第二句的It承接前一句的the gym，behind the lobby说明健身房在大厅后面。题目要填一个地点词，因此只填lobby，不加the。lounge对应的是across from，不能用上一题的方位关系代替本句。

spokenEvidence.quote: The gym is across from the lounge. It is behind the lobby.

questions.prompt: Complete Anna’s sentence with ONE WORD: “This is not a gym. This is a ____.”
questions.evidence: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.
questions.explanation: Anna在这句实际台词里亲口说This is a rooftop，所以空格填rooftop。这里不依靠括号中的镜头地点说明；即使看不到画面，也能从说出的词完成。rooftop表示屋顶平台，与此前说到的parking garage不同。

spokenEvidence.quote: This is not a gym. This is a rooftop.

questions.prompt: What does Pete invite Anna to do at the end?
questions.evidence: I want to work out too! Join me!
questions.explanation: Pete先说自己也想锻炼，再说Join me，意思是邀请Anna一起参加刚提到的活动。因此是一起锻炼，而不是去休息室或离开大楼。判断Join me的具体活动要联系前一句，不能只把它机械译为“加入我”。

spokenEvidence.quote: I want to work out too! Join me!

review.textEvidence: Codex item-by-item source comparison; no human/psychometric calibration claim

blindComparison.scope: Source text only; not an actual listening check, human examiner review or difficulty calibration.
